@welcome_title.description: The product name, shown as the welcome page title.

@welcome_subtitle.description: One-line description under the welcome page title.

welcome_hint_sidebar: Pick a tool from the left.

@welcome_hint_sidebar.description: Welcome page card telling the user to choose a tool in the sidebar.

welcome_hint_titlebar: Open settings from the title bar to switch the theme and language.

@welcome_hint_titlebar.description: Welcome page card telling the user where the theme and language controls are.

@tools.description: Name of the sidebar navigation group in the main window.

@settings_title.description: Title of the settings dialog and of the title bar button that opens it.

@settings_general.description: Settings tab with the appearance and language choices.

@settings_hotkeys.description: Settings tab with the global and in-app hotkeys.

@settings_hotkey_unset.description: Placeholder of the hotkey recorder when no hotkey is set.

@settings_hotkey_global.description: Settings group for hotkeys that work while DevToys is in the background.

@settings_hotkey_global_window_toggle.description: Settings row for the global hotkey that shows or hides the main window.

settings_hotkey_global_window_toggle_hin: Works while DevToys is in the background.

@settings_hotkey_global_window_toggle_hi.description: Explanation under the global hotkey's name.

@settings_hotkey_app.description: Settings group for hotkeys that work while the window is focused.

@settings_hotkey_app_sidebar_toggle.description: Settings row for the in-app hotkey that toggles the sidebar.

settings_hotkey_app_sidebar_toggle_hint: Works while the window is focused.

@settings_hotkey_app_sidebar_toggle_hint.description: Explanation under the sidebar hotkey's name.

@settings_theme.description: Heading of the theme choices in the settings dialog.

@theme_system.description: Theme choice that follows the system's light or dark appearance.

@theme_light.description: Theme choice that always uses the light appearance.

@theme_dark.description: Theme choice that always uses the dark appearance.

@settings_language.description: Heading of the language choices in the settings dialog.

@language_system.description: Language choice that follows the user's preferred languages.

@open_settings.description: Tooltip of the title bar button that opens the settings dialog.

@close.description: Button that closes the settings dialog.
